plan: A mischievous mage who puts her enemies to sleep then hits them from very far with her bubble and her star.
aSurveiller: Her E (Sleepy Trouble Bubble). It puts you to sleep, then her Q hits you twice as hard: stay behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her bubble (E) stops on them.
If you're drowsy, use Cleanse or run: you're about to fall asleep.
forces: Puts to sleep with her E.
Picks up spells from the ground.
faiblesses: Her spells are easy to see coming.

sorts.P: After a spell, her attack is empowered.
sorts.Q: Projectile that hurts more from far away.
